notes.title: Update for Day Night System
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31224779/9253810b0875406247bffb6eaaecd3ef735e947d.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31224779/239919a2a8974c1f70a77144882418ff45e3a7c7.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31224779/14e70aeea35d6f2f58939ed9ab8ae62441da99cc.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31224779/851c2cb65d7cce0d11ba5feb6d8df7c03b3e1a5a.jpg[/img]

Right now, there are daytime, dusk and night time in this game. Time will gone while doing nothing and anything in Single player mode.  
Before this update，there is only daytime with sunshine. Player can only past a day by sleep.

 I think now would better than before. At the same time, I think it is the time for my game to change EA state as formal published. I started to make a new game ieda too. Thanks everyone who supported me.

notes.title: recent updates, redid the map's icons, rebalanced all the resources system, rewrote some text content to emphasize this is a survival game
notes.content:
I did many small changes in recent updates in June. 
1. redid all the icons on the Map 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31224779/941c1ac4b533fa6ab87dba03c6abb237bfb11a6e.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31224779/836f3841a2d0fdbe2d5b0f339a89d640c0fdddf1.jpg[/img]
2. add a mission direction signal on the small map.
3. cancel shining for the icons on the map
4. adjusted the AI behaviours
5. rebalanced all the resources system, reduce food and vigor consumption in normal time, increase consumption in sleeping time and resting time. increase food income from shopping, increase vigor income from sleeping and resting.
6. player will never be under arrest directly when sleeping on the car, but may be surrounded by the polices. 
7. fixed some colliders error.
8. add some tips to emphasize that this game is a survival game, not a game like GTA. You have to know what is my core design fot this game. 
9. In Multiplayer mode, reduce the interactive time from rescuing other players from the prison.

notes.title: Multiplayer Mode is now available, in 3/3/2018 Big Update
notes.content:
I am happy to tell everyone that Multiplayer mode in my game is available now.
Everyone who own my game can update this content for free.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31224779/f58fccf325a5cacb20eea70c30e8cb30c2d306a2.png[/img]

Map in Multiplayer mode is about 7 time bigger than the map in Single player mode, its land area is about 4000M*4000M as a island. It is more beautiful than single player mode.

it support more than 10 people playing together, player can  act Escape Expert or Police. 

Its gameplay is also new, something like Battle Royale with Escape Expert type.

Please try to play it, then welcome to give me feedback, I will keep improving my game.

notes.title: About the car movement updates in 21/12/2017 before the winter solstice
notes.content:
Some player said the card movement is too unreasonable, actually, I just want to made the movement simple and easy to control before, but seems not satisfy the players' feeling, so I made some changes today.

1. you can't turn around without move forward any more
2. No "reverse is backwards" problem any more, when you go forward, left is turning left, when you go backward, left is turing right.
3. some balance changed
4. add a Level UI, future I will make more uses about it.
5. fixed the NPC position is not touching the ground problem
6. add more tips.

notes.title: Big update about AI, update in 15/12/2017
notes.content:
Today, I optimized the behaviours of AI. I know the AI is really bad before, but now it become better.
1. It will avoid the wall and won't hit the wall when turning a corner. 
2. Police AI will start to arrest you after you do something to him. then you will have to help yourself to escape out of this town as a new work. 
3. Add some new Achievement such as NO ZUO NO DIE.

notes.title: About updates around 13/12/2017, a new function similar with "back mirror"
notes.content:
I updated several times in these two days, somethings changed:

1. added more police at the begining, police will also spawn every 60 seconds or every 30s when one of them found you. Go to sleep is the only way to reset their amount. You can see more polices, I think it is very exciting,

2. added a new function similar with "back mirror", I don't know how to describe it. there will be a second screen on the top right side when you are being tracked, it will show the police car is behind you. You can close it in the "Option" If you don't like it.

3. changed some setting about buying something, Originally, There is a risk probability, the citizen may identified you and call the police, but you still can buy something successfully. Now If so, you will also have another 50% fail to buy something, and have to run away.

4. Fixed the problem about the bank robbers mission's introduction

5. Add a data about Exp, you can't see it in the game UI, but I already put it in the code and your saved data, I will make it useful in the future.

My next plan is trying to make multiplayer mode.

notes.title: Early Access Version is now available today with very low price， and about the first update patch

I also have some players report that the resources are consuming too fast, so I change the balance immediately, but I have to say that this is one of the feastures of this game, it have to be a constraint. The first mission is also very difficult because I want players fail in the begining work, just let you know what is the game look like at the begining.

Another problem is the Space button has a BUG, I fixed that in a new version now

This game may be a little bit too difficult to new player, but it is fun for me, so I am going to make a difficulty option in the feature
